story: With 19 riders within a minute, the final time trial promised a thrilling conclusion. Thornley set an early benchmark that stood for a long time, before Küng eventually powered to the stage victory. Behind him, Fisher-Black, Romeo and Brenner all emerged as contenders for the overall victory, keeping the battle for the general classification alive until the final moments. Scaroni lost the leader’s jersey as Brenner ultimately secured the general classification, completing a Tudor double alongside Küng’s stage win.
